purpose: Pre-outcome funding settlement mark inputs for crypto_tsmom_flow_increment_20261008_v4

source.funding_history_note: The historical /fapi/v1/fundingRate response returned an empty markPrice for the sampled 2021 settlement. Settlement marks therefore use the documented markPriceKlines endpoint.

construction.method: For each funding event, join the Binance 1h mark-price candle whose open timestamp equals the event timestamp truncated to the UTC hour. Store the candle open as mark_price, plus the source bar timestamp and event-to-mark offset.
construction.lookahead_policy: Use only the candle open at the settlement hour. This mark observation precedes the funding event by 0-47 milliseconds in the audited inputs.
construction.limitation: mark_price is the hourly mark-candle open, not the exact exchange settlement transaction mark. Binance states that actual funding transaction timing can deviate by up to 15 seconds.
